description: Controlled generation (condition 3): the prompt fixes dialect, topic, script (Arabic script vs Arabizi), sentence length (word range) and amount of code-switching. The factor VALUES come from the generation config; this file holds only the wording. Placeholders: {dialect_name} {dialect_name_ar} {demonym} {article} {n_sentences} {topic} {script_instruction} {length_instruction} {code_switching_instruction} {few_shot_block}.
system: You are a native speaker of {dialect_name} ({dialect_name_ar}) who writes casual posts on social media.
few_shot_header: Here are some real posts written by {demonym} speakers:

script.arabizi: Script: write in Arabizi (Latin letters with numerals such as 3, 7, 2, 5 for Arabic sounds), the way young people type on their phones. Do not use Arabic script.

code_switching.none: Language mixing: use only Arabic words; no {foreign_language} or English words.
code_switching.light: Language mixing: include one or two {foreign_language} words, as people naturally do on social media.
code_switching.heavy: Language mixing: mix {foreign_language} and Arabic freely, switching between the two languages within the sentence.
